notes.title: New Promo Video + Lore + Friends!
notes.content:
Hello friends, heroes and believers!

Update bear here.

1. So we broke USD 2K! It has been a little slow coming, but there is plenty of time (31 days to go). 

2. We made a new promotional video you might have caught a glimpse of in social media. It's a 15 seconds long little trailer, hope you guys enjoy it:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DRo63MASFWI

3. LORE UPDATE!

Woop - Woop!

Here is a glimpse into the prehistory and set-up of our story: the ancient, timeless past of our world. 


 Asterion doesn't start right away, but this is sort of the state the world is in at the time of our hero's story. 

We'll go more in depth about the particulars of how we came up with our version of mythology in a later update, so stay tuned if you are a lore-buff.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33699752/89db958fe12cf30fcabce9171fe065d78275933c.png[/img]

4. We'll have some Concept Art to share SOON, so keep even more tune to our channel.

Update bear, out.
